notes.title: Lots of fixes and improvements!
notes.notes:
Hello all! Thanks to recent feedback we've gone in and made some changes that will hopefully make the game less frustrating and more enjoyable. The main change was making Hardcore mode not send you back a level when you died. We also made the par times a little more manageable!

In addition to that we also fixed several bugs, including one that would have prevented an achievement from unlocking. Yikes! We're running a sale for the next two weeks and hope those who have been on the fence will decide to join us for some marble platforming goodness!

notes.title: New levels available now!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the release of a new update for Lost Marbles which adds a whole new 10 level chapter! That's a whopping 33% more levels!

These new levels include:

     - new visual elements
     - 9 new music tracks
     - new hazards including a teleporter!
     - 2 more skins and achievements to unlock

And of course this is all 100% free! We hope you enjoy the new levels and look forward to adding more to the game in the future.

notes.title: Lost Marbles v1.2 - Coming this Friday!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that work on the new version of Lost Marbles is complete and we are in the final testing stages. We are expecting a release this Friday July 18th.


We will release full patch notes on Friday but until then here is a taste of whats in the new version.

[list]
    [*]10 New Levels
    [*]New Teleport Mechanic
    [*]9 New Original Songs
    [*]New Hazards
    [*]And a ton of bug fixes!
[/list]

 
Remember this update is 100% FREE! See you Friday!

notes.title: Now it's your turn! We want your Feedback!
notes.notes:
We just want to thank everyone who purchased Lost Marbles. We are just 2 guys making the games we'd love to play, we really appreciate all the support we've gotten.

Now comes the fun part. We want to make this game amazing and we need your help! Pop into the forums and tell us what you like/dislike about Lost Marbles. Everything is up for critique, Don't like the art? Have an idea for a hazard? Do you really like a specific level or mechanic?

[b]
Our plan is to release weekly updates taking into account your feedback! We really want to make the game that our fans want to play!
[/b]

We already have tons of updates in the pipeline in addition to [b]10 FREE LEVELS![/b] Stick with us and I promise you won't be disappointed :)
